metadata.title: Anthropomorphic Lion Cowboy in Desert Landscape

retrievalProfile.description: A cinematic digital painting of a lion-headed cowboy in a sun-drenched desert canyon, featuring a guitar slung over his back and classic western leather gear.

recipe.visualDefinition: A medium shot of an anthropomorphic lion dressed as a cowboy, standing centrally against a vast desert canyon. The character wears a wide-brimmed brown hat, a leather jacket, a neck scarf, and a large belt buckle. An acoustic guitar neck is visible behind his shoulder. The lighting is warm and directional, mimicking a late afternoon sun, with soft painterly textures throughout the landscape and fur.
coreVisualRelationships: The lion's head is the primary focal point, framed by the cowboy hat.
The guitar neck creates a diagonal line that balances the character's vertical posture.
The warm golden light unifies the character with the desert background.
The low-angle perspective gives the character a heroic, commanding presence.
coreInvariants: Classic western cowboy attire (hat, scarf, leather)

compositionAndHierarchy.subjectPositionAndScale: The character is centered and occupies the middle and foreground, shown from the waist up.
compositionAndHierarchy.visualAnchor: The lion's face and eyes, shaded by the brim of the hat.
compositionAndHierarchy.movementAndEyePath: Starts at the face, moves down the leather jacket to the belt buckle, then follows the guitar neck upward toward the sky.
compositionAndHierarchy.negativeSpace: The upper third of the image is open sky with soft, hazy clouds, providing breathing room for the detailed character.

colorSystem.dominantColorRole: Warm ochre and terracotta tones in the landscape and clothing.
colorSystem.contrastColorRole: Cool blue-grey in the neck scarf and shadows of the canyon.
colorSystem.accentColorRole: Bright highlights on the lion's muzzle and the metallic belt buckle.
colorSystem.saturationAndValueRelationship: High value contrast between the dark hat/jacket and the bright sky; saturation is naturalistic but warm-leaning.

typographyAndGraphicLanguage.pairingStrategy: Single typeface used with varying weights or tracking for hierarchy.
graphicDevices: Vertical pipe separator between text elements

candidateDirections.reason: Captures the high-contrast, elegant feel of the metadata text.
Provides a classical, cinematic feel with sharp serifs.

twoStageComposition.backgroundInstruction: Generate a digital painting of an anthropomorphic lion cowboy in a leather jacket and hat, standing in a golden-hour desert canyon with a guitar on his back. Leave the top 15% of the image as clear sky for text.
twoStageComposition.overlayInstruction: Add metadata text in a light cream, high-contrast serif font at the top center. Use all caps and wide tracking, separating phrases with a thin vertical line.

verificationChecks: Is the lion's head anatomically integrated with the human body?
Is the lighting consistent across the character and the landscape?
Is the text legible against the sky without being distracting?
Does the guitar neck appear correctly positioned behind the shoulder?
